brief: public static DocumentBuilder getDocumentBuilder() throws TikaException{}
method_comment: * Returns the DOM builder specified in this parsing context. * If a builder is not explicitly specified, then a builder * instance is created and returned. The builder instance is * configured to apply an {@link #IGNORING_SAX_ENTITY_RESOLVER}, * and it sets the ErrorHandler to null. * * @return DOM Builder * @since Apache Tika 1.13
